summary: Phase 2 Shift Management testing complete. Backend: 100% (14/14 tests passed after fixing route ordering bug). Frontend: 100% (all Phase 2 features verified). Fixed critical backend bug where PUT /api/shifts/time-off-balance was being intercepted by /{shift_id} catch-all route.

backend: GET /api/shifts/time-off-balance/{workspace_id}/{user_id} - returns vacation/sick/personal balance with total/used/remaining (200)
PUT /api/shifts/time-off-balance - updates allocated days for a user (200) - FIXED route ordering bug
POST /api/shifts/time-off - creates new time off request with workspace_id, user_id, start_date, end_date, type, reason (200)
GET /api/shifts/time-off/{workspace_id} - returns all time-off requests for workspace (200)
GET /api/shifts/export-pdf/{workspace_id} - returns HTML PDF report with Content-Disposition header (200)
POST /api/shifts/swap-request - creates swap request with shift_id, requester_id, target_user_id, reason (200)
frontend: Time-Off Balance section shows 3 balance cards (Vacation, Sick Leave, Personal) with progress bars
Balance cards display remaining/total days (e.g., '15 / 15 days')
'Request Time Off' button opens dialog with type selection (Vacation/Sick/Personal/Other), date range, reason
Time-Off dialog shows available balance info
'Request Swap' button opens dialog with shift selector, team member selector, reason field
Export dropdown has 'Export as CSV', 'Export as JSON', and 'Export as PDF Report' options
Requests tab shows pending requests with Approve/Reject buttons
Requests tab badge shows count of pending requests (5)
'Back to Workspace' link visible and functional

bugs_fixed.root_cause: Route ordering conflict - the catch-all route @router.put('/{shift_id}') at line 280 was intercepting requests to /time-off-balance before they could reach the specific route
bugs_fixed.fix: Moved @router.put('/time-off-balance') route definition BEFORE the /{shift_id} catch-all route, and moved TimeOffBalanceUpdate model to the models section at the top of the file

seed_data_creation: Test time-off requests and swap requests created during testing in workspace b3478da2-7782-425a-9fa7-2dbc4f22d047
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 Shift Management features fully functional. Backend routes in /app/backend/routes/shifts.py. Time-off balance auto-creates default (vacation:15, sick:10, personal:5) if none exists. PDF export returns HTML file. Frontend components in /app/src/pages/ShiftManagementPage.jsx. All data-testid attributes properly set: time-off-balance-section, request-time-off-btn, request-swap-btn. Phase 1 Time Clock features still working.

reproduction_steps: 1. Send PUT request to /api/shifts/time-off-balance with valid JSON body
2. Request was being routed to /{shift_id} endpoint instead
3. 'time-off-balance' was interpreted as a shift_id, which doesn't exist
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: FastAPI routes are matched in order of definition. The catch-all route @router.put('/{shift_id}') was defined before @router.put('/time-off-balance'), causing the path parameter to match first
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Moved specific routes before catch-all routes. Added comment to prevent future regressions. Moved TimeOffBalanceUpdate model to top of file with other models.
